messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: auto-pager fired for service=gpu-infer-west2, alert=OOM_RATE_HIGH. 32 cuMemAlloc failures in 3m across pool=infer-west2-g-pool-7. Examples: 
  'cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory' 
  metric snapshot: gpu_vmem_pct=89%, slab_alloc_fail_rate=0.004, active_slots=78/100. Link: https://redwood.alerts/PD-8675309

PagerDuty: PAGER FIRED -> PD-8675309 (P1) | Service: gpu-infer-west2 | Escalation policy: oncall-inference | Assigned: Maya

Maya: acked in PD. I'm taking this — starting triage. Any recent deploys?

Chris: noticing a canary rollout of quantized-model v1.3-8bit that started ~15:25 UTC. Error correlation + logs show cuMemAlloc spikes when sequence length > 2048.

Jonah: customer impact: 12 active customers showing 502/503 tail errors, ~8% request failure rate over last 10m. Latency spikes to 3s then OOM.

Maya: running quick grep on runtime logs, pulling stack traces. If we need immediate mitigation, plan: 1) pause rollout, 2) reroute ~20% traffic to v1.2 fallback, 3) attempt allocator slab compact on affected nodes.

Maya: executing diagnostic command now:
```
kubectl -n inference logs gpu-infer-west2-7 -c runtime | grep -E "cuMemAlloc|OOM|allocator-slab" -A 4
```

OpsBot: log excerpt from gpu-infer-west2-7:
```
[15:31:02] runtime: cuMemAlloc(0x7ff...) FAILED: out of memory
[15:31:02] runtime: allocator-slab: unable to allocate 131072 bytes -> slab fragmentation
[15:31:03] runtime: fallback to host-pageing initiated for k 0x12
```

Lina: I'm prepping a +1 GPU scale for infer-west2-g-pool-7 (hot-add). ETA ~3m. Doing graceful drain of new node.

Maya: paused canary rollout (control-plane): `rollout cancel --name quantized-model-v1.3` — pause confirmed. Rerouting 20% traffic to fallback via router policy.

Chris: starting allocator compact job on nodes with high slab fragmentation. Command:
```
infractl node compact-slab --region west2 --pool infer-west2-g-pool-7 --concurrency 2
```

Nate: ping CS + SEs: customer-impacted list (12) notified via status page and PS queue. Drafted note, awaiting ops confirmation.

Maya: observed immediate drop in new OOM events after reroute + scale; slab_alloc_fail_rate down by 70% in the last minute. Monitoring closely.

PagerDuty: PD-8675309 updated: mitigation_in_progress. Next update in 15m or on significant change.

Jonah: I'm standing up extra tracing to watch KV/cache usage for quantized model. Will also watch GPU memory fragmentation metrics.

Maya: handing off active response to Jonah for next 30m (scheduled handoff at 16:00 UTC). All mitigation steps logged in PD. Leaving notes: paused rollout, scaled pool +1, ran compact, reroute 20% to v1.2 fallback.

Jonah: taking over. Thanks @Maya. I'll keep PD updated and coordinate with infra to revert any changes when stable.

Chris: follow-up: root cause hypothesis = allocator-slab fragmentation interacting poorly with 8-bit quantized kernels for long sequence lengths. Action items: create regression test for long seqs on quantized builds, add slab compaction to node maintenance, add mem-pressure alert earlier (pre-oom threshold).

Maya: :thumbsup: I'll file follow-ups in infra backlog and link to PD. For now incident moves to mitigation state; customers being remediated.

OpsBot: metrics snapshot at 15:50 UTC: OOM events 4 (down from 32), client error rate 1.2% (down from 8%).

Nate: CS updated status page and emailed top 5 affected accounts. Responses queued.

Jonah: confirming stability at 15:57 UTC — no new cuMemAlloc failures for 7m. Will keep an eye for 20m then mark PD as resolved if stable.

Maya: thanks team. If anything re-triggers, @PagerDuty will re-open PD.

Jonah: closing loop: PD-8675309 -> status: mitigated, owner=Jonah, will transition to post-incident review.

Maya: adding incident notes to #postmortems and scheduling a 30m blameless RCA tomorrow. :calendar: 

Jonah: copying logs and commands used into PD ticket for runbook updates. :folder:
